sloka: यथान्ये विविधै रोगै; पीड्यन्ते प्राणिनो मया ।ते न ते प्रभविष्यन्ति मयि प्रीते न संशयः ।। ७.१८.२७ ॥
transliteration: yathānye vividhai rogai; pīḍyante prāṇino mayā ।te na te prabhaviṣyanti mayi prīte na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.18.27 ॥

translations.english: Just as other living beings are tormented by various diseases through me, those diseases will not affect you when I am pleased, of this there is no doubt.
